map.输入总体大小、置信水平、误差范围和预期比例，计算问卷调查或 A/B 实验所需的最: Enter the population size, confidence level, error range and expected proportion, and the tool computes the minimum sample size for a questionnaire survey or an A/B test, applies the finite population correction automatically and shows the full step-by-step derivation from the z critical value to the rounded sample size.
map.可选有限总体修正：填入总体大小 N 后自动折算: Optional finite population correction: enter the population size N and it is applied automatically
map.预期比例 p 可调，未知时取 0.5 即最保守估计: The expected proportion p is adjustable; 0.5 when unknown gives the most conservative estimate
map.输出 z 临界值、理论样本量 n0 与取整后的推荐样本量: Output the z critical value, the theoretical sample size n0 and the rounded recommended sample size
map.展示完整分步计算过程，便于写进报告或论文: Shows the complete step-by-step calculation, ready to drop into a report or paper
map.纯前端计算，数据不上传: Pure front-end calculation, nothing is uploaded
map.问卷调研：确定要回收多少份问卷才够用: Questionnaire research: work out how many questionnaires you need to collect back
map.A/B 实验：估算每组最少需要多少流量: A/B testing: estimate the minimum traffic each group needs
map.学术研究：为论文方法部分提供样本量依据: Academic research: a sample size basis for the method section of a paper
map.填写误差范围 E（如 5 表示 ±5%）: Enter the error range E (5 means ±5%)
map.选择置信水平（常用 95%）: Choose a confidence level (95% is common)
map.填写预期比例 p，未知时保持 0.5: Enter the expected proportion p; leave it at 0.5 when unknown
map.若总体有限，填入总体大小 N 启用修正: If the population is finite, enter the population size N to enable the correction
map.点击「计算」，查看推荐样本量与分步推导: Click Calculate to see the recommended sample size and the step-by-step derivation
map.p = 0.5 时 p(1−p) 最大，样本量最保守，适合未知比例的情形: At p = 0.5, p(1−p) is largest, so the sample size is the most conservative, which suits the case where the proportion is unknown
map.误差范围减半，所需样本量约变为原来的 4 倍: Halving the error range makes the required sample about 4 times larger
map.有限总体修正会显著减少样本量，总体越大修正效果越弱: The finite population correction can markedly reduce the sample size, and the larger the population the weaker the correction
map.结果已向上取整，实际执行时建议再预留 10%~20% 的无效样本: The result is already rounded up; in practice reserve another 10%-20% for invalid samples
map.误差范围该填 5 还是 0.05？: Should the error range be 5 or 0.05?
map.按页面单位填写即可：填 5 表示 ±5%，与 p 的取值口径保持一致。: Just fill in the unit shown on the page: 5 means ±5%, matching the convention used for p.
map.为什么推荐值比理论值大？: Why is the recommended value larger than the theoretical one?
map.理论值 n0 通常为小数，实际调查必须取整数，故向上取整。: The theoretical n0 is usually a decimal, but an actual survey must use a whole number, so round up.
